chunks: And (Joseph) asked the man he knew would be released: "Remember me to your lord;" but Satan made him forget to mention this to his lord, and Joseph remained in prison for a number of years.
ai.seo_question: Why did Joseph remain in prison for several more years after his fellow prisoner was released?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between divine decree and human agency, where the companion's forgetfulness (nisyān) is attributed to Shaytan's influence rather than mere negligence, illustrating the spiritual trials of the righteous. This period of prolonged imprisonment is viewed as a necessary refinement for Joseph's eventual elevation to power, demonstrating that patience (sabr) in adversity is a precursor to divine favor. The event underscores the theme of tawḥīd in action, where even a righteous figure relies on God's timing despite human intermediaries.
